about: What must keep working whenever PushFlow or anything near it changes, and the automated test that guards each part. scripts/checks/protected_features.py (run by the checks workflow on every push) fails when a file named here is gone, when its test is no longer run by a workflow, or when a text it must hold is gone: a guard cannot be deleted or unplugged without this file saying so. 'needs_hardware' is what no automated test here can show. docs/PUSHFLOW2.md explains the rules.

features.what: Capture cards: formats, the mode asked for and the mode agreed, compressed decoding, colour range, HDR detection, the capture card list
features.needs_hardware: A real capture card. Nothing in CI opens one; a card works when the owner or a user's report says so.

features.what: PS5 Remote Play: pairing, reconnect, controller forwarding (buttons that stayed pressed), sound
features.needs_hardware: A PS5. The wire test runs against a loopback, never a console.

features.what: Moonlight / Sunshine, Xbox streaming with damaged-frame recovery, window and screen capture, files, the frame input API
features.needs_hardware: A Sunshine host and an Xbox for the streaming sources.

features.what: Every frame generation method stays selectable and really generates: none may be selected and silently do nothing

guards.contains: amfFrcActive() || pushFlowActive() ||

features.needs_hardware: The vendor methods (need their makers' cards). Only PushFlow runs through the real graph in CI, on the software renderer.

features.what: PushFlow: Fast / Balanced / Quality and their own motion sizes, a motion size chosen apart from the tier (off means unchanged; the too-slow watch always takes a cheaper step), the rebuild at full size (the shader is what the motion contract says), half precision and its approval, PushFlow 2's experiments (each off unless switched on, the emergency stop, a damaged preference reads as off) its encoder cache (the pictures are the whole model's, whatever is kept or made anew) and Guard (a still picture and a followed object come out exactly as without it; it never moves a place further from the real frame), the adaptive multiplier; Predict (off by default: every batch without it ends with its real frame as it always did; with it a still picture stays exact and no forecast is further from the truth than holding the real frame)
